'''Bowen''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}. He first appears in the quest [[Photos of Jinzhou]], where he introduces the player to the [[Camera]] system.

==Profile==
He is a journalist from the [[Pioneer Association]], and works for a magazine called ''Wutherium Geography''. His career has consisted of photographing places to share their beauty with those who cannot travel, and he has won awards for his work. However, due to his age, as well as a hand injury, he is ready to retire. <ref>[[Photos of Jinzhou]]</ref>

He grew up with a close relationship with his parents, and they were the ones who gifted him his first camera.
